Record Class HealInsightModels.HealInsight

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.shaft.doctor.history.HealInsightModels.HealInsight
Record Components:
attemptId - heal attempt id
reportPath - absolute or workspace path to the report JSON
status - HealingDecision status
originalLocator - original failed locator
proposedLocator - selected candidate locator when present
confidence - decision confidence 0..1
actionOutcome - action metadata outcome (PASSED / FAILED / PENDING / …)
postActionVerification - post-action verification token
reason - decision reason
canProposeSourcePatch - whether doctor_propose_healed_locator is allowed (FR-002)
primaryAction - review-gate primary action (SC-001 / SC-002)
primaryActionLabel - human label for the primary action (blank when NONE)
proposalManifestPath - existing proposal manifest path when already persisted
sourcePatchProposed - whether the report recorded a prior proposal emission
Enclosing class:
HealInsightModels

One heal insight derived from a HealingReport JSON file.
